solutions.explanation:
Multiplication and division by the same nonzero number undo each other, so one factor of \(3\) cancels the division by \(3\). Regrouping the remaining factors gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
314\times3\times3\times6\div3\div100
&=314\times(3\times6)\div100\\
&=314\times18\div100\\
&=5652\div100.
\end{aligned}
\]
Dividing by \(100\) moves the decimal point two places to the left, so the answer is \(56.52\).
